description: Find and interpret memory, undefined-behavior and data-race bugs in C and C++ programs with Clang/GCC sanitizers (AddressSanitizer, LeakSanitizer, UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer, ThreadSanitizer, MemorySanitizer): choose the right sanitizer, build correctly, read the report, and avoid invalid combinations. Use when a native program crashes with heap corruption, use-after-free, uninitialized reads, intermittent segfaults, leaks, signed overflow or data races, or when adding sanitizer jobs to CI. Not for general C/C++ style (use c-development or cpp-development), CPU/time profiling (use performance-profiling), Rust or managed languages, or kernel sanitizers (KASAN) and exploit development.
